title: Weekly Email Digest Notification Settings

evidence.excerpt: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.

outcomes: A member can change the weekly email digest setting between on and off in notification settings.
When the setting is changed to on, the member begins receiving weekly email digest emails according to the weekly schedule.
When the setting is changed to off, the member stops receiving weekly email digest emails after the change.
Changing this setting does not affect delivery of account-security messages (see BEH-security-messages-unaffected).

evidence.excerpt: The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.

outcomes: After a member sets weekly email digests to a chosen state, signs out, and signs back in, the notification settings display that same state.
The persisted state controls email delivery after sign-in: if on, the member receives weekly digests; if off, the member does not receive weekly digests.
The setting is not reset to a default or previous value by sign-out/sign-in.

evidence.excerpt: Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.

outcomes: When weekly email digests are switched off, account-security messages are still delivered.
The weekly email digest off state does not alter the delivery or frequency of account-security messages.
Account-security messages continue according to their own existing triggers/settings regardless of the weekly digest setting.

evidence.excerpt: A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

outcomes: A newly created member has the weekly email digest setting set to off automatically.
The new member does not receive weekly email digest emails until they manually switch the setting to on.
The default off state is visible in notification settings on the member's first access.

timing_reviews.start_question: When a member switches weekly email digests on, what event starts the weekly schedule (e.g., immediately after the switch, the next calendar week, the next configured send time)?
timing_reviews.time_basis_question: Is the weekly interval based on calendar weeks, seven elapsed days, or a configured schedule, and in which time zone?
timing_reviews.boundary_question: On what exact day and time is a weekly digest sent each week, and is that send time included in the current cycle?
timing_reviews.after_question: If a member switches weekly email digests off mid-cycle or before the next scheduled send, what happens to any digest that was already queued or scheduled?

interface_reviews.request_question: How does the member supply the weekly email digest on/off choice in notification settings (e.g., a toggle, radio buttons, an API call), and what exact values represent on and off?
interface_reviews.response_question: How is the result of the change communicated (e.g., success confirmation, saved state, error message), and what happens if the update fails or the setting cannot be saved?
interface_reviews.ui_applicability_question: Which signed-in member roles or account states see and can modify the weekly email digest control, and what does the control show when the setting is off versus on?

owner.question: Who owns the decisions and acceptance for these weekly email digest behaviors?

delivery_date.question: What is the delivery date or release target for these weekly email digest behaviors?

open_questions: What specific message types count as account-security messages for the BEH-security-messages-unaffected behavior?
